title: Practice 3: Someone who does or is something

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **родителей** — роди́тель: parent; (dated, literary) father. Wiktionary: роди́ть + -тель.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **после́дователь** — follower. Source: Wiktionary, «-тель» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тель#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **зри́тель** — spectator, onlooker, viewer. Source: Wiktionary, «-тель» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тель#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**Зрители** — зри́тель: spectator, onlooker, viewer; audience. Wiktionary: зреть + -тель.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **изда́тель** — publisher (one who publishes, especially books). Source: Wiktionary, «-тель» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тель#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.q: The publisher told me to make my book shorter.
exercises.why: **Издатель** — изда́тель: publisher (one who publishes, especially books). Wiktionary: изда́ть + -тель.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: зри́тель — spectator, onlooker, viewer; изда́тель — publisher (one who publishes, especially books); мысли́тель — thinker; иссле́дователь — researcher.
**мысли́тель** — thinker. Source: Wiktionary, «-тель» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тель#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.q: Germany is known for being the country of poets and thinkers.
exercises.ru: Германия известна как страна поэтов и ___.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **иссле́дователь** — researcher. Source: Wiktionary, «-тель» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тель#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
